The graph above shows the function $y=\operatorname{csc}⁡(\frac{4x}{5}+C),$ where $C$ is a constant. Given that $-\pi <C<\pi ,$ what is the value of $C?$
question.worked_solution:
The parameter $C$ represents a horizontal shift of the function.

First, we rewrite the function by factoring the horizontal stretch factor, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =\operatorname{csc}⁡(\frac{4x}{5}+C) \\  & =\operatorname{csc}⁡(\frac{4}{5}(x+\frac{5C}{4}))\end{aligned}
$$

From the graph, we see that the graph of cosecant has been shifted by $\frac{7\pi }{8}$ units to the **right**. Therefore

$$
\frac{5C}{4}=-\frac{7\pi }{8}\,⟹\,C=-\frac{7\pi }{10}.
$$
